DPO Privacy Centre (East Africa) says the Personal Data Protection Office convened a validation workshop on 1 and 2 April 2026 on six draft instruments.

DPO Privacy Centre (East Africa) says six draft instruments, including amendment, retention and breach notification regulations for 2026, were tabled at the Office's validation workshop on 1 and 2 April 2026 and are not yet gazetted.

UGA.note: The post states no law status, ratification or authority action beyond a workshop on draft instruments.

facts.fact: DPO Privacy Centre (East Africa) says the Personal Data Protection Office held a validation workshop with stakeholders from across sectors on 1 and 2 April 2026 on six named draft instruments, left the window open for written comments, and the Centre filed its comments on 20 May 2026.
